readme: Country -> state/governorate -> city data for the location dropdowns. Keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. The COUNTRY list itself does NOT come from this file - it comes from the country_picker package, so every country in the world is offered. This file only supplies the states and cities under a country. A country missing from 'countries' simply has no state/city options yet; add a new entry with the same shape and it works with no code change. 'name' is English, 'name_ar' is Arabic; the service picks by the app locale and falls back to 'name' when 'name_ar' is absent.
